**IRVING, TX /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 16, 2026 /** Envela Corporation today announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company reported quarterly revenue of $43.4 million and quarterly earnings per diluted share of $0.15.


**Management Commentary**


“Through nine months we have earned $0.65 per diluted share, nearly double the prior-year period and already more than all of 2025,” said John Loftus, CEO of Envela. “Precious metals traded well below January’s record levels, customer selling normalized and Consumer revenue stepped down from last year’s elevated base. Even so, quarterly diluted earnings per share rose 15.4 percent to $0.15, operating income grew 11.5 percent to $4.7 million and gross margin expanded to 29.4 percent of revenue on a favorable sales mix. That is the model working as designed.”


“Consumer segment gross margin rose to 17.5 percent from 11.5 percent a year ago as mix shifted away from wholesale, and our Commercial segment grew revenue again on steady demand for re-commerced technology assets and components,” Loftus continued. “We generated $33.5 million in operating cash flow year to date, retired the Consumer segment’s bank note, repurchased 67,435 shares and ended September with $35.6 million in net cash, up from $8.2 million at year-end. Today we repaid our remaining $7.4 million of bank term notes with cash on hand, leaving a single $0.7 million note outstanding and significant flexibility to invest in growth and return value to shareholders. We remain mindful of precious metals volatility and an uncertain macro backdrop, and confident in a business built to perform across commodity cycles.”

**Third Quarter 2026 Consolidated Operating Highlights**


- Third quarter revenue was $43.4 million, compared to $57.4 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Third quarter gross margin was $12.8 million, or 29.4% of revenue, compared to $13.1 million, or 22.8% of revenue, in the prior-year quarter.
- Third quarter operating expenses were $8.1 million, compared to $8.9 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Third quarter operating income was $4.7 million, or 10.8% of revenue, compared to $4.2 million, or 7.3% of revenue, in the prior-year quarter.
- Third quarter net income was $3.9 million, or $0.15 per basic and diluted share, compared to $3.4 million, or $0.13 per basic and diluted share, in the prior-year quarter.
- Third quarter Adjusted EBITDA was $5.2 million, or 12.0% of revenue, compared to $4.7 million, or 8.1% of revenue, in the prior-year quarter.


**Third Quarter Consumer Segment Operating Highlights**


- Consumer segment revenue was $30.8 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $45.1 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Consumer segment gross margin was $5.4 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $5.2 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Consumer segment operating expenses were $3.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $4.0 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Consumer segment operating income was $1.9 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $1.2 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Consumer segment net income was $1.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $0.9 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Consumer segment Adjusted EBITDA was $2.1 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $1.4 million in the prior-year quarter.


**Third Quarter Commercial Segment Operating Highlights**


- Commercial segment revenue was $12.6 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $12.3 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Commercial segment gross margin was $7.4 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $7.9 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Commercial segment operating expenses were $4.6 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $4.8 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Commercial segment operating income was $2.8 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $3.0 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Commercial segment net income was $2.3 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $2.4 million in the prior-year quarter.
- Commercial segment Adjusted EBITDA was $3.1 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $3.3 million in the prior-year quarter.


**Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and Liquidity**


- Cash and cash equivalents were $43.7 million on September 30, 2026, compared to $18.2 million on December 31, 2025.
- The Company’s long-term debt was $8.1 million on September 30, 2026, compared to $9.9 million on December 31, 2025.
- Subsequent to quarter end, on November 16, 2026, the Company repaid in full its two notes payable with Farmers State Bank, with an aggregate balance of approximately $7.4 million, with cash on hand at maturity.
- Total shareholders’ equity was $82.9 million on September 30, 2026, compared to $67.1 million on December 31, 2025.
- For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, consolidated operating cash flows totaled $33.5 million, compared to $6.1 million in the prior-year period.


**Share Repurchase Program**


For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company repurchased 67,435 shares of common stock at a cost of $1.1 million. Since the beginning of the share repurchase program in March of 2023, Envela has spent more than $5.8 million to purchase 1,028,590 shares of common stock under the share repurchase program authorized through March 31, 2028. The Company is authorized to purchase 1,100,000 shares, of which 71,410 shares remained available for repurchase as of September 30, 2026.

**About Envela®**


Envela Corporation ([NYSE American | Texas: ELA](https://pr.report/tmak) ) is a leading provider of re-commerce services, driving innovation at the forefront of the circular economy. We Reuse, Recycle, and Reimagine to offer consumers alternatives, contribute to environmental sustainability, and maximize product value. As a sustainability-focused company, Envela extends product lifecycles to minimize resource consumption and carbon emissions. By focusing on our core strengths, we create exceptional value and strive to leave the world better than we found it.


The company operates through two primary business segments: Consumer and Commercial. The Consumer segment includes retail stores and online platforms offering premium brands and luxury hard assets, while the Commercial segment delivers tailored re-commerce solutions to clients, including many Fortune 500 companies. To learn more about our innovative approach, visit[Envela.com](https://pr.report/tmal) .
